279692978.description: This vintage collection includes seven small clear specimen containers, each holding a different mineral or rock sample in colors such as clear, amber, green, brown, and yellow. The containers and lids show signs of age and dust accumulation, suggesting long-term storage. Additionally, there is one larger loose mineral specimen that is rough, translucent, and light pink in color, possibly rose quartz. No brand or manufacturer markings are visible on any of the items.
